description: SSOT: every Cloudflare API token permission group GeoHarness needs, per feature. Names follow https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/ (citation cf-api-permissions). Preflight probes each enabled feature with a harmless GET; a probe proves the token can reach the resource, the write itself is proven when the stage applies it.

workers-custom-domain.description: Attach the site's domains to the Worker as Custom Domains

pages-deploy.description: Create the Pages project and upload a deployment

pages-custom-domain.description: Attach domains to the Pages project and create their proxied CNAMEs

zone-read.description: Find the zone that serves each domain

rewrite-rules.description: URL Rewrite Transform Rules that serve markdown twins on Accept: text/markdown

email_obfuscation.description: Turn Email Obfuscation off (it rewrites HTML that agents and twins read)

rocket_loader.description: Turn Rocket Loader off (it rewrites script tags and hurts Lighthouse)

zstd.description: Compression Rule preferring zstd for the site's host

bot_fight_mode.description: Turn Bot Fight Mode off so AI crawlers receive HTTP 200

ai_bots_protection.description: Set AI bots protection to disabled so AI crawlers receive HTTP 200
